facts.text: John expressed a passion for improving education and infrastructure in their community.

evidence.quote: I'm passionate about improving education and infrastructure in our community. Those are my main focuses.

facts.text: John mentioned that lack of education and crumbling infrastructure negatively affected his neighborhood during his childhood.

evidence.quote: Growing up, I saw how lack of education and crumbling infrastructure affected my neighborhood.

facts.text: John believes that proper funding for schools and infrastructure will prevent future generations from experiencing similar issues.

evidence.quote: I don't want future generations to go through that, so I think schools and infrastructure should be funded properly.

facts.text: John shared a photo of a school that had received funding, showing men working on the building.

evidence.quote: Here's a pic of a school last year, after they got the funding. [image: a photo of a group of men working on a building]
